ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier. If provided, used to find existing profile to update.

Source.description: The AI provider source name (e.g., OpenAI, Azure, Ollama). Required for new profiles.

Name.description: Unique technical name for the profile.

TitleType.description: How the session title is generated.

PersonaId.description: Optional technical name of the AI persona this profile links to. An empty value unlinks the persona, and leaving the key out keeps the current link.

ConnectionName.description: Optional name of the provider connection the profile uses.

ChatDeploymentName.description: Chat deployment technical name for the AI model.

UtilityDeploymentName.description: Utility deployment technical name for the AI model.

SystemMessage.description: Shortcut for Properties.AIProfileMetadata.SystemMessage. Ignored when the profile's system message is locked.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

Properties.description: Extended profile properties. Known metadata objects are listed here, and additional feature-specific objects are also allowed.

AgentMetadata.description: Known agent metadata for agent profiles.

Availability.description: Controls whether the agent is only available when selected or always injected into orchestration.

AllowToolInvocation.description: When true, the agent runs its own selected tools when another assistant calls it. When false or missing, it runs without tools.

AIProfileMetadata.description: Known prompt and model tuning metadata for the profile.

InitialPrompt.description: Optional initial prompt automatically injected for chat profiles.

SystemMessage.description: The system instructions for the profile.

PastMessagesCount.description: Number of prior chat messages to include in context.

UseCaching.description: Whether distributed caching is enabled for the profile when the tenant allows it.

FunctionInvocationMetadata.description: Known tool selection metadata for the profile.

Names.description: Tool names that can be invoked by this profile.

AgentInvocationMetadata.description: Known on-demand agent selections for the profile.

Names.description: Agent profile names that can be invoked by this profile.

PromptTemplateMetadata.description: Known prompt template selections applied before or alongside the system message.

Parameters.description: Template parameter values. Keys are parameter names and values are strings.

Templates.description: Ordered prompt template selections for the profile.

AIPersonaMetadata.description: The AI persona this resource links to, by the persona's technical name. Applied when the AI Personas feature is enabled.

PersonaId.description: Technical name of the linked persona.

Parameters.description: Liquid arguments used when rendering the persona instructions.

AnalyticsMetadata.description: Known analytics and outcome tracking metadata for chat profiles.

Description.description: Goal description used for scoring guidance.

ConversionGoals.description: Configured conversion goals for chat analytics.

DataSourceMetadata.description: Known external data source selection for retrieval augmentation.

DataSourceId.description: Identifier of the selected AI data source.

AIDataSourceRagMetadata.description: Known retrieval augmentation parameters for an attached AI data source.

IsInScope.description: Whether answers must stay within the retrieved documents.

Filter.description: Optional OData filter applied to retrieved data.

ObjectTypes.description: Optional object types (for example content types) the retrieved documents are limited to. Empty searches every type.

AIProfileSessionDocumentsMetadata.description: Known session upload capabilities for the profile.

DocumentsMetadata.description: Known profile document attachments and retrieval behavior.

Documents.description: Documents explicitly attached to the profile.

DocumentTopN.description: How many top document matches to include.

MaxIndexableCharacters.description: Optional limit on the characters of a document that are indexed. Null uses the site default.

DescribeFiguresInUploads.description: Whether figures in uploaded documents are described by an AI model while indexing. Null uses the site default.

MemoryMetadata.description: Known AI memory configuration for the profile.

EnableUserMemory.description: Whether user memory is enabled for the profile. Null uses the site default.

EnableSessionMemory.description: Whether the profile keeps a memory of the current session. Null uses the site default.

EnablePastConversations.description: Whether the profile may recall the user's past conversations. Null uses the site default.

ClaudeSessionMetadata.description: Known Claude orchestrator overrides when the AI Claude Orchestrator feature is enabled.

ClaudeModel.description: Claude model override for this profile.

CopilotSessionMetadata.description: Known Copilot orchestrator overrides when the AI Copilot Orchestrator feature is enabled.

CopilotModel.description: Copilot model override for this profile.

IsAllowAll.description: Whether Copilot should run with the allow-all flag.

AIDeploymentParametersMetadata.description: Values of the model parameters the profile's deployments expose (for example reasoningEffort), keyed by the parameter's technical name.

Values.description: Parameter values sent with requests to the chat deployment.

UtilityValues.description: Parameter values sent with requests to the utility deployment.

AIProfileMcpMetadata.description: Known MCP connection selections for this profile.

ToolNames.description: Per connection identifier, the names of the tools the profile may use from it. A connection with no entry, or a null entry, exposes every tool; an empty array exposes none.

AIProfileA2AMetadata.description: Known A2A connection selections for this profile.

Settings.description: Profile settings. Known settings objects are listed here, and additional feature-specific settings are also allowed.

LockSystemMessage.description: Prevents recipe or editor updates from changing the system message.

IsListable.description: Whether the profile is listed in the admin UI. Defaults to true.

IsRemovable.description: Controls whether the profile can be deleted from the admin UI.

InitialResponseHandlerName.description: Initial non-AI response handler to invoke before the main orchestrator.

IsOnAdminMenu.description: Whether the chat profile appears on the Orchard admin menu.

EnableDataExtraction.description: Enables extracting structured values from chat sessions.

ExtractionCheckInterval.description: How often data extraction runs during the session.

SessionInactivityTimeoutInMinutes.description: How long the session must be inactive before final extraction runs.

AllowMultipleValues.description: Whether multiple values can be captured.

IsUpdatable.description: Whether later session turns can update the extracted value.

FieldType.description: The type of the extracted value. Enum and List values are limited to AllowedValues.

AllowedValues.description: The values an Enum or List field may take.

ToolInstanceNames.description: Tool instances available to post-session processing.

Type.description: How the task result is generated.

AllowMultipleValues.description: Whether the task can return multiple values.

Options.description: Predefined options used when Type is PredefinedOptions.

ToolInstanceNames.description: Tool instances the task may call.

PostSessionTasks.description: Tasks executed after the chat session closes.

ChatMode.description: Preferred input mode for this profile.

ConversationDeploymentName.description: Optional technical name of the speech-to-speech (realtime) deployment used in conversation mode. Leave empty to use the site default.

VoiceName.description: Optional speech synthesis voice for conversation mode.

EnableTextToSpeechPlayback.description: Whether assistant responses should be played back with text-to-speech.

AIProfileGuardrailSettings.description: Topic guardrails: what the assistant must not discuss, checked on the customer's messages, the replies, or both.

CheckCustomer.description: Whether the customer's messages are checked against the topics.

CheckReplies.description: Whether the assistant's replies are checked against the topics before they are sent.

Topics.description: Identifiers of the guardrail topics: System Prompt templates in the 'Guardrail topic' category.

OtherTopics.description: Other topics refused, described in a sentence or two, for this profile alone.

PlaceholderReply.description: What the assistant says instead when a guardrail triggers. Empty uses a default.

AIProfileDataPrivacySettings.description: What the profile's conversations keep once they end.

StorageMode.description: Everything keeps the transcript; RedactPersonalData removes personal data from it; MetadataOnly keeps only the conversation's metadata.

StorageModeSinceUtc.description: When the storage mode last changed (ISO 8601, UTC). Conversations active after it get the mode. Set by the admin when the mode changes.

RetentionDays.description: Days without activity after which a conversation is deleted. Null keeps conversations.

NamesToKeep.description: Names that are not personal data and are kept when personal data is redacted, such as the assistant's, the business's and its staff's names.

AIProfileSpeakingStyleSettings.description: The speaking styles the assistant follows.

Styles.description: Identifiers of System Prompt templates in the 'Speaking style' category, for example speaking-style-echo-verification, speaking-style-nato-spelling, speaking-style-speech-normalization, speaking-style-fuzzy-name-matching, speaking-style-ai-disclosure, speaking-style-scope-limits, speaking-style-filler-words or speaking-style-high-empathy.

AIProfileSpeechSettings.description: How the assistant speaks and listens in voice conversations.

SpeakingRate.description: How fast the profile speaks, as a multiple of the voice's normal pace (1 is normal), clamped to 0.25-4. Null uses the deployment's own pace.

SpeakingEmotion.description: Emotion the voice speaks with, as one word such as calm or excited, for providers with an emotion control (Cartesia). Others ignore it.

Text.description: The word or phrase to pronounce differently.

MatchCase.description: Whether Text matches only with the same letter case.

PronunciationEntries.description: Pronunciation replacements applied before text is spoken.

FallbackTextToSpeechDeploymentName.description: Technical name of the text-to-speech deployment used when the primary one fails.

BoostedKeywords.description: Words the speech recognizer is biased toward, such as product names.

RecognitionLanguages.description: Languages the recognizer should expect, as BCP-47 tags. The first is the primary language.

InterruptionSensitivity.description: How readily the caller's speech interrupts the assistant, from 0 (never interrupted) to 1 (any caller speech interrupts it). Null uses the default.

EnableBackchanneling.description: Whether the assistant says short acknowledgements while the caller speaks.

BackchannelPhrases.description: The acknowledgements used for backchanneling. Empty uses a small built-in set.

AIProfileLanguageSettings.description: The languages the assistant may speak.

AllowedLanguages.description: Languages the profile may converse in, as BCP-47 tags. Empty means no restriction.

StartingLanguage.description: BCP-47 tag of the language a conversation starts in. A conversation language set by the host (for example from a conversation variable) overrides it.

AIProfileFlowSettings.description: The conversation flow: a workflow whose AI conversation stages guide the conversation.

WorkflowTypeId.description: Identifier of the workflow type that starts with an AI Conversation Flow Started event and holds the stages. Empty turns the flow off.

Flexible.description: Whether every stage's instructions are given at once, so a caller who jumps between tasks is followed, rather than only the current stage's.

AIProfileContactMemorySettings.description: The memory the assistant keeps about each CRM contact.

UseMemory.description: Whether what is remembered about the contact is given to the assistant.

SaveMemory.description: Whether the memory is updated after each conversation.

AIProfileContactFieldMappingSettings.description: Copies extracted values onto the CRM contact when the conversation closes.

FieldName.description: Name of the data extraction entry the value comes from.

ContactField.description: The contact field the value is written to.

Mode.description: Whether the value replaces the field, fills it only when empty, or is appended to it.

Mappings.description: The mappings, one per extracted value.

PromptSecurityProfileSettings.description: Per-profile overrides of the site's chat rate limits. A null member uses the site setting.

MaxMessagesPerWindow.description: Most messages a signed-in user may send per RateLimitWindow.

RateLimitWindow.description: The message rate limit window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

Limit.description: How many are allowed in the window.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

AnonymousMessageRateLimitTiers.description: Message limits for anonymous visitors; every tier applies.

Limit.description: How many are allowed in the window.

Window.description: The window, as a time span such as 00:01:00.

AnonymousSessionStartRateLimitTiers.description: Session start limits for anonymous visitors; every tier applies.

MaxAnonymousSessionsPerWindow.description: Most sessions an anonymous visitor may start per AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.

AnonymousSessionRateLimitWindow.description: The anonymous session window, as a time span such as 01:00:00.

WebMcpProfileSettings.description: Whether the profile may use the tools the visitor's page offers through WebMCP.

AllowPageTools.description: Whether the assistant may call the page's tools.

AllowConsequentialPageTools.description: Whether the assistant may also call page tools that change something (consequential tools).

Profiles.description: The AI profiles to create or update.
